fsid.description: UUID of the Ceph cluster. Must be unique per cluster.

public_network.description: Network CIDR used for client-facing traffic (MON, MDS, RGW, OSD public).

cluster_network.description: Network CIDR used for internal cluster traffic (OSD replication, journal traffic).

mon_hosts.description: List of monitor addresses in host:port format (typically 3 or 5 for quorum).

auth_cluster_required.description: Authentication method required for cluster communication. Set to 'none' only for testing.

auth_service_required.description: Authentication method required for service daemons (OSD, MDS, RGW).

auth_client_required.description: Authentication method required for client connections (CephFS, RBD, etc.).

log_file.description: Base path for log files. '$name' is replaced by daemon name.

max_log_size.description: Maximum log file size in MB before rotation. Set to 0 to disable rotation.

mds_default_data_pool.description: Default data pool to use for CephFS if not specified per filesystem. Optional.

allow_insecure_global_id_reclaim.description: Whether to allow insecure global ID reclaim (not recommended for production).

mds_mode.description: Global MDS mode: 'active' (normal), 'standby' (reserve), or 'standby-replay' (replay logs for fast failover).

mds_max_mds.description: Maximum number of active MDS daemons. Set >1 for parallel metadata operations (CephFS v15+).

mds_max_mds_instances.description: Maximum total MDS instances (active + standbys) allowed in the cluster.

mds_filesystem.description: Name of the default CephFS filesystem to manage. Used only if auto-creating filesystems.

mds_standby.description: List of daemon IDs (e.g., ['a','b']) or ['*'] to auto-assign standbys. Standbys replace failed active daemons.

extra_features.description: Additional feature flags for standby-replay (e.g., 'dirfrag', 'inode64'). Optional.

mds_standby_replay.description: List of MDS daemons in standby-replay mode (for fast failover).

host.description: Hostname or IP to bind this daemon to. Required if overriding defaults.

mds_standby_replay.description: Enable standby-replay for this daemon? (Overrides global mds mode).

mds_filesystem.description: Optional filesystem name for this daemon (if different from global).

mds_standby.description: Force this daemon into standby mode?

mds_configs.description: Daemon-specific overrides. Use only if fine-grained control is needed.

metadata_pool.description: Metadata pool name. Auto-generates '$name_metadata' if omitted.

data_pools.description: List of data pools. Auto-generates '$name_data' if omitted.

standby_for_rank.description: Rank this standby MDS should fail over to. Only applies to standbys.

filesystems.description: Configure multiple CephFS filesystems in one cluster.
